name: get_host_shell
description: Inspect the default shell, startup directory, and commands across activities, including commands whose initial calls are still waiting. Command IDs belong to this runtime. Finished handles have bounded retention; full logs remain independently available.

name: run_host_shell
description: Run a command in a fresh shell. If execution and cleanup finish during the wait, return a final result. Otherwise return command_id and callback_id, registering one completion observation for this session so it can sleep while waiting. A callback_id confirms the registration even if the returned command snapshot is already final. Initial previews and continuation reads are independent and may overlap. Full output remains in log files.

cwd.description: Literal path; relative paths and omission use the kernel's startup directory.

login.description: Load startup files through -lc; default false.

mode.description: batch (default) has closed stdin; pipe accepts streamed input; terminal provides terminal behavior with merged stdout/stderr. Batch and pipe preserve output bytes; terminal processing can alter them.

timeout_ms.description: Stops the command at expiry. Omit to run without a deadline.

max_output_bytes.description: Shared by stdout and stderr after JSON encoding; default 16384. Metadata and native media are additional.

interpretation.description: Present final stdout text, up to 16 KiB, as an image URL passed unchanged to the model service. Image bytes are recognized automatically.

yield_ms.description: How long this call waits before returning control, default 1000 ms. Zero returns immediately. This does not limit command duration.

name: continue_host_shell
description: Read output, send input, or control an existing command. Activities share per-stream read cursors, independently of the initial preview and completion callback. This call keeps the original completion destination and registers no new callback. The first continuation after completion can supply complete stdout as an image or image URL once across activities, independently of text cursors. Completion callbacks carry text descriptions of media. A finished background handle retires when its output is drained.

command_id.description: Runtime command handle returned by run_host_shell or listed by get_host_shell.

text.description: Limited to 16384 UTF-8 bytes. Only one write can be pending; stdin.pending and stdin.error report delivery.

eof.description: After this text, close pipe stdin or send terminal Ctrl-D. Terminal input remains writable.

name.description: Send SIGINT, SIGTERM, or SIGKILL, respectively. Interrupt targets the terminal foreground group; terminate and kill cover its original session. Without a terminal, signals target the command's process group.

action.description: Apply input or control before reading output; omit to read only. Controls remain available while another call waits. Resize requires terminal mode.

yield_ms.description: Wait for unread output or completion, default 1000 ms. Zero returns the current state immediately.

max_output_bytes.description: Shared by stdout and stderr after JSON encoding; default 16384. Metadata and native media are additional.
